card.fact_statement: The People's Action Party won 87 seats in the 2025 Singaporean general election.
card.source_span: The PAP retained its two-thirds supermajority, winning 87 seats and improving its popular vote share from the previous election to 65.57%.

card.fact_statement: Lakas–CMD won 104 seats in the House of Representatives in the 2025 Philippine general election.
card.source_span: Lakas–CMD remained the most dominant party inside the House of Representatives, as 104 of its congressional candidates in the 2025 midterm elections had secured seats
